name: Bayou DeView (AGFC water trail) — Highway 17 Boating Access to Bank of Brinkley Boating Access
blurb: Bayou DeView through the cypress-tupelo swamp of Dagmar WMA between AGFC water-trail accesses.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Put-in Highway 17 Boating Access: exact agency access pin. Take-out Rock Island RR Boating Access: approximate area only. AGFC Bayou DeView Water Trail (Dagmar WMA): "Boating hours are limited during waterfowl seasons." Check the current Arkansas Hunting Guidebook. Arkansas law: no glass containers in canoes, kayaks or tubes; keep food and drink in sealed containers, carry a closable trash bag affixed to the boat and use floating drink holders; children 12 and under wear life jackets. Banks and gravel bars beside private land may be private — use public accesses. Mileage: preliminary, measured along USGS river geometry (no agency mileage found).
